prompt_translation: Keep the P9 anatomy unchanged but give the neck, clavicle, wrists, hands, ankles and foot contact believable human soft-tissue volume.
Hands should read as real young-adult hands: subtle knuckles and joints, natural nail presence, soft skin and no plastic mannequin surface.
Keep clavicles and neck transitions soft and anatomical rather than graphic CG lines.
